112-4377-6496.manaNeeded: {10}{U}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
112-4377-6496.easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
112-4377-6496.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Walk the Aeons and exiling the original Walk the Aeons with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Walk the Aeons copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Walk the Aeons and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Walk the Aeons's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Walk the Aeons and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Walk the Aeons's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
112-4377-6496.notes: You can use Clockspinning as a way to cast a spell before starting the combo if needed. Since you need to ensure Walk the Aeons is always the second spell cast each extra turn after Clockspinning, it is recommended to not have any other suspended cards when beginning the combo. Otherwise, you can ensure Walk the Aeons is second by casting Clockspinning with the other suspend abilities on the stack during your upkeep.
